content: If the API SomeIpTp_RxIndication() is called, the SOME/ IP TP module shall check whether the received payload bytes are dividable by16 in case the More Segment Flag is set to '1'. If the received payload bytes are not dividable by 16 in this case, • The current assembly process shall be interrupted as defined by SWS_SomeIp Tp_00054. • The API Det_ReportRuntimeError() shall be called with the runtime error code SOMEIPTP_E_ASSEMBLY_INTERRUPT.
